Product artifact, driver commit, workflow checkout, and run are separately identified; this review does not conflate product SHA d8ff02e, frozen product source 5248736, or driver SHA fa05a93.

Samples show pressure level 1, memory above the stated 4 GiB requirement, zero swap, and no admission reasons. Stale 371053 journals were excluded.
verdict_b.privacy: The receipt stores clipboard booleans only, not clipboard values. Guest auth storage is reported empty and account observation is boolean. The retained screenshots show the synthetic Harbor Dental localhost fixture. The originals do include run/extension identifiers and host resource measurements, so treat them as test evidence rather than public artifacts without review.
verdict_b.false_positive_limits: The fixture-specific oracle imports no product converter and checks representative fixture-specific content/format invariants, sentinel replacement, exact menu order, clipboard read, and permission restoration. Since raw clipboard text is deliberately omitted, this review cannot independently replay the oracle against copied values; boolean outcomes rely on the recorded run. Predicate success does not establish every possible page's semantic correctness or untested referrals/reload behavior.
verdict_b.causal_limit: The zero-target pointer failure identifies the observed stopping condition only. This review makes no inference about its root cause or whether it belongs to driver or product behavior.
